sources.title: DINOv3 - OpenCV
sources.snippet: DINOv3 is a next-generation vision foundation model trained purely with self-supervised learning. It introduces innovations that allow robust dense feature learning at scale with models reaching 7B parameters and achieves state-of-the-art across a wide spectrum of computer vision tasks.

sources.title: DINOv3: Self-supervised learning for vision at unprecedented scale
sources.snippet: DINOv3 scales self-supervised learning for images to create universal vision backbones that achieve absolute state-of-the-art performance across diverse domains, including web and satellite imagery.
